draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.80, the 207th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 16th of 20 at S. He lasted until pick 259, well after his grade rank (207th): he slid relative to the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 67 tackles in 2021, 7th of 19 Ss in his class with stats.
